name: Hetzner Inference API
description: Experimental EU-hosted inference API that is free of charge while it remains in beta.
overview: Hetzner, the German cloud and hosting company, runs an experimental OpenAI-compatible inference API launched in July 2026. It serves Qwen models with very large context windows on EU servers and is not billed while experimental. A regular Hetzner account with full billing details is required.
free_access: Free of charge during the experimental phase
notes: Some users are asked for a card or ID to verify new Hetzner accounts, even though inference is not billed. No SLA.
